purpose: Data construction only: teacher-native calibration sessions on calibration_v2 (a per-cell prefix of calibration_v1: the same instances), regenerated with the asynchronous runner. The battery session's round-synchronous runner was stopped before this unit to protect its completed measurements from the hard stop, and the teacher's measured ~4.5k tokens per trace (battery_20261018_092345 teacher_dev round 1: 3,221,916 tokens / 720 turns) makes 672 prompts sufficient for every planned consumer.

sampling.generate: teacher official preset T0.6/top_p0.95/top_k20/min_p0, one seeded request per turn

session_limit_note: 16384 tokens end to end is a DATA-CONSTRUCTION bound for calibration sessions, recorded per session as length_limited; it is never applied to a measurement

hardware.why: the teacher's long traces make generation KV-bound: 144 KiB per token, ~500k tokens of cache on 80 GB vs ~230k on a 48 GB card, i.e. about twice the concurrency per dollar; measured 1.9k tok/s on this card
